interface.longDescription:
A growing collection of skills for coding agents.

thai-natural-writing (v2): Humanizes and rewrites Thai text (often AI-generated) so it reads like a real person wrote it. Combines deep de-AI structural editing (eliminating fake contrasts, dramatic one-liners, forced triads, and hype words) with audience-specific vocabulary (Developer, Business, General, Documentation). Keeps technical terms Thai practitioners say in English (Architecture, Backend, API, Deploy, Cache, Queue) and preserves all code, numbers, and facts.
defaultPrompt: Use $thai-natural-writing to humanize and make this Thai sound natural: (Thai text)
